content.short: Day1x is a fully compliant Australian crypto exchange with a flat 0.25% transaction fee and no deposit fees.
content.description: Day1x is a crypto exchange built to be affordable and transparent for buying and selling digital assets. It charges a flat 0.25% transaction fee for all users, regardless of volume or order type, and offers $0 deposit fees by absorbing third-party charges. Security is a core priority: all assets are insured, protected with advanced technology, and continuously monitored. The platform emphasizes accessibility for all users, not just high-volume traders, and provides clear, straightforward pricing with no hidden costs.
